name: Stone Watch
story: Stone wardens stand between the steps of the tower.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: A warden stands on every landing. Their stone shells close after the first strike of each turn.

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: One step at a time. We do not have to reach the top in one breath.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Arith stops on the landing and points to Mara's loose shoelace. She laughs once and bends to tie it. He waits.

name: Mirror Siege
story: In the glass, Mara is still standing where she has already left.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: The corridor reflects their movements a moment late. Mara stops; her reflection takes another step.

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: If I go back to the bench, will I forget this road too?

afterStory.speaker: Mara Venn
afterStory.text: For now I would rather keep walking.

name: Unwritten Act
story: A witness asks Arith to sign an account of things he has never seen.

beforeStory.speaker: Ink Witness
beforeStory.text: Sign here. The account is already written.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Arith pushes the sheet back across the desk.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: On a blank sheet, Arith draws the west door, two figures, and the path they took out. He leaves it on the desk.

name: Emperor's Revision
story: The Marshal writes Mara's refusal down as a command to remain.

beforeStory.speaker: Revision Marshal
beforeStory.text: You have declined departure. Remain in the court.

beforeStory.speaker: Mara Venn
beforeStory.text: I declined your offer. I did not decline to leave.

afterStory.speaker: Mara Venn
afterStory.text: I do not need him to write it correctly before I can go.
